description: Source code for Electron application management within Playwright, including launching Electron, handling console messages, and managing the Electron app lifecycle.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents a running Electron application, manages its lifecycle, console messages, and window handles.

classes.name: Electron
classes.description: Main class to launch Electron applications within Playwright, handles process spawning and connection setup.

methods.name: ElectronApplication._onConsoleAPI
methods.description: Handles console API calls from Electron's runtime and emits console messages.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Electron application by enabling runtime and evaluating startup script.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.process
methods.description: Returns the child process of the Electron app.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.context
methods.description: Returns the browser context associated with the Electron app.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.browserWindow
methods.description: Returns a handle to the Electron BrowserWindow for a given page.

methods.name: Electron.launch
methods.description: Launches a new Electron application with specified options, sets up debugging and connection.
